title: Open-ended Scientific Discovery with Possibilistic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.11289v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous scientific discovery with LLMs requires generating and testing hypotheses adaptively as evidence accumulates while maintaining statistical validity. Existing anytime-valid methods can handle data-dependent hypotheses, but open-ended discovery poses a deeper challenge: the best discovered hypothesis may still be the best of a bad lot, with better explanations yet undiscovered, while even background knowledge such as physical laws may require revision in light of new findings. In response, we formalize the problem as Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) using possibility theory. We introduce abductive utility, a computable measure of discovery progress, and possibility frontier search, the first algorithm for AASD, which maintains anytime validity and achieves $\varepsilon$-optimal abductive utility asymptotically under suitable conditions. translated_title: 基于可能性推理的开放式科学发现
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的自主科学发现，需要在证据不断积累的过程中自适应地生成并检验假设，同时保持统计有效性。现有的任意时刻有效方法可以处理数据依赖的假设，但开放式发现带来了更深层的挑战：已发现的最佳假设可能仍属于“劣中选优”，更好的解释尚未被发现，而即便是背景知识（如物理定律）也可能需要根据新发现加以修正。为此，我们利用可能性理论将该问题形式化为溯因自主科学发现问题。我们提出了溯因效用，这是一种可计算的发现进展度量方式，并提出了可能性前沿搜索——首个针对AASD的算法。该算法在任意时刻均保持有效性，并在适当条件下渐近实现ε-最优的溯因效用。在合成数据与真实世界科学发现任务上的实验显示出强劲的表现。
tldr: 本文利用可能性理论将开放式自主科学发现形式化为溯因自主科学发现问题，首次提出可计算的“溯因效用”度量与首个算法“可能性前沿搜索”，在保持任意时刻统计有效性的同时渐近实现ε-最优的溯因效用。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes open-ended autonomous scientific discovery as Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) using possibility theory, introducing abductive utility as a computable measure of discovery progress and possibility frontier search, the first algorithm to maintain anytime validity while asymptotically achieving ε-optimal abductive utility.
